name: Mechanic Workshop Manager
description: Run an auto mechanic workshop end to end: manage customers and their vehicles, track job cards through the bay, log parts used, and raise invoices from one linked dashboard. Includes 5 forms and 1 app.

packMeta.name: Mechanic Workshop Manager
packMeta.description: Run an auto mechanic workshop end to end: manage customers and their vehicles, open and track job cards through the bay, log parts used, and raise invoices — all linked together.
packMeta.author: FormLogic

forms.title: Customer
forms.description: Add a workshop customer with their contact details so you can link their vehicles and jobs.

fields.label: New Customer
fields.description: Capture the customer details so you can book their vehicles in for work.

properties.placeholder: Preferred contact times, account terms, history…

forms.title: Vehicle
forms.description: Register a vehicle against a customer with make, model, year, plate, odometer and fuel type.

forms.title: Job Card
forms.description: Open a job card for a vehicle: complaint, status, technician, labour hours, priority and date in.

properties.placeholder: Describe the reported fault or the work requested…

forms.title: Parts Used
forms.description: Log a part consumed on a job card, with quantity and unit cost.

forms.title: Invoice
forms.description: Raise an invoice against a job card with labour, parts and total amounts.

apps.name: Workshop
apps.description: A workshop operations hub for an auto mechanic: track customers, vehicles, job cards, parts used and invoices from one dashboard.

roles.name: Workshop Owner
roles.description: Full access to all workshop forms.

roles.name: Mechanic
roles.description: Technicians who work job cards and log the parts they use.

roles.name: Service Advisor
roles.description: Front-desk staff who book vehicles in, manage customers and raise invoices.
